title: Full day · about 7–9 hours

stops.title: Topkapi Palace
stops.text: Start early and use the entry or host meeting time on your ticket. The suggested IWC combo excludes Harem entry; buy it separately if wanted. Leave time for the courtyards and security.

stops.title: Lunch & a walk through the square
stops.text: Keep this break flexible. The routes between the main sights are short, but ticket collection and queues use more time than the walk.

stops.title: Ticket delivery & arrival
stops.text: Save the emailed Hagia Sophia and Basilica Cistern entry QR codes. For Topkapi, follow the host meeting point and arrival time in your confirmation.

stops.title: Hagia Sophia upper gallery
stops.text: Keep extra time for security and the ramp. This paid visitor route does not include the ground-floor worship area.

stops.title: Basilica Cistern
stops.text: Allow roughly 5–10 minutes to walk from Hagia Sophia. Download any audio before going underground; use the session on your ticket.

stops.title: Sultanahmet Square
stops.text: Finish with an exterior view of the Blue Mosque and a walk through the square. An interior mosque visit needs its own time allowance.

notes: Times are planning estimates, excluding unpredictable queues. Check opening hours, ticket sessions and any temporary closures for your date.
This is a busy day. Blue Mosque is an exterior stop; add an interior visit only if time and visitor hours allow. Splitting the three paid attractions over two days is more relaxed.
Basilica Cistern has separate day and evening sessions, with a published 18:30–19:30 visitor break. Do not assume a day ticket covers evening entry.
Add your visit date to flag Tuesday and Friday restrictions. Holiday and temporary closures are not checked automatically.
